definitions.explanation: Contains no sugar. Commonly seen on food and beverage labels.

examples.japanese: {無糖|むとう}のコーヒーをください。
examples.english: I'll have an unsweetened coffee, please.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{無糖|むとう}の{飲|の}み{物|もの}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Sugar-free beverages are popular these days.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために、{無糖|むとう}のヨーグルトを{毎朝|まいあさ}{食|た}べている。
examples.english: For my health, I eat unsweetened yogurt every morning.

notes:
Commonly seen on product labels for food and beverages. Modifies nouns with の.

COMPOUND: {無|む} (without) + {糖|とう} (sugar)

SUGAR LEVEL LABELS:
- {無糖|むとう}: sugar-free
- {微糖|びとう}: slightly sweet (common for canned coffee)
- {低糖|ていとう}: low sugar
- {加糖|かとう}: sugar added

SIMILAR {無|む}～ LABELS:
- {無塩|むえん}: salt-free
- {無脂肪|むしぼう}: fat-free
- {無添加|むてんか}: additive-free
- {無農薬|むのうやく}: pesticide-free

USAGE:
Very common in convenience stores and supermarkets. {無糖|むとう}のお{茶|ちゃ} and {無糖|むとう}コーヒー are staples of Japanese vending machines.
